sentences.text: This floating-rate business term loan to an MSE proprietor was sanctioned on 2026-03-15, so the 2026 UCB directions on pre-payment charges apply.
The Tier 3 UCB no-charge rule for business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises applies only up to a sanctioned amount/limit of ₹50 lakh, and this loan is ₹60 lakh.
Because the specific no-charge rule does not cover this case, pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB.
The evidence does not include the bank’s approved policy or any disclosed pre-payment charge term for this loan, so whether a charge may actually be levied cannot be confirmed from the record.

missing.searched: Looked for the UCB’s approved policy and the sanction letter/loan agreement or KFS disclosure stating the pre-payment charge for this specific loan; none was provided in the evidence.
